entries.question_en: What are the four core relationships of a BHW?
entries.question_fil: Ano ang apat na pangunahing ugnayan ng isang BHW?
entries.answer_en: The four relationships are an authored teaching organizer: community concerns and choices; authorized guidance from the designated midwife/RHU health professional; administrative support through responsible barangay contacts; and fellow BHW experience and routine task coordination. Each has limits; confirm local roles rather than promising faster service.
entries.answer_fil: Ginawang balangkas sa pagtuturo ang apat na ugnayan: alalahanin at pagpili ng komunidad; awtorisadong gabay ng itinalagang midwife/RHU health professional; suportang administratibo ng responsableng barangay contact; at karanasan at karaniwang pagtutulungan ng kapwa BHW. May hangganan ang bawat isa; tiyakin ang lokal na papel sa halip na mangako ng mabilis na serbisyo.

entries.question_en: Who should a BHW approach for a personal health question?
entries.question_fil: Sino ang dapat lapitan ng BHW para sa personal na tanong pangkalusugan?
entries.answer_en: Seek the locally designated authorized health professional for a personal health question, using confirmed local arrangements. Officials and peer experience do not replace professional assessment. This organizational guidance is not diagnosis, a symptom threshold or a universal triage sequence.
entries.answer_fil: Lumapit sa lokal na itinalagang awtorisadong health professional para sa personal na tanong pangkalusugan, ayon sa natiyak na lokal na kaayusan. Hindi kapalit ng propesyonal na pagtatasa ang opisyal o karanasan ng kapwa BHW. Gabay pang-organisasyon ito, hindi diagnosis, tagal ng sintomas o iisang proseso ng triage.

entries.question_en: Who should a BHW approach for administrative support, like transport or supplies?
entries.question_fil: Sino ang dapat lapitan ng BHW para sa suportang administratibo, tulad ng transportasyon o kagamitan?
entries.answer_en: Ask the responsible local coordinator or barangay contact about activity arrangements and requested administrative support. Confirm whose role it is and what resources are available. Do not guarantee transport, supplies or a response, or treat administrative support as clinical assessment.
entries.answer_fil: Itanong sa responsableng lokal na coordinator o barangay contact ang kaayusan ng aktibidad at hiling na suportang administratibo. Tiyakin kung kaninong papel ito at anong kagamitan ang magagamit. Huwag mangako ng transportasyon, kagamitan o sagot, o gawing klinikal na pagtatasa ang suportang administratibo.

entries.question_en: Why does a BHW's relationship with fellow BHWs matter?
entries.question_fil: Bakit mahalaga ang ugnayan ng BHW sa kapwa niya BHW?
entries.answer_en: Fellow BHWs share routine work experience, coordinate agreed tasks and help identify questions to clarify with the responsible person. Peer help does not replace authorized professional assessment or a resident’s preferences. Confirm roles locally.
entries.answer_fil: Nagbabahagi ang kapwa BHW ng karanasan sa karaniwang gawain, nag-uugnay ng napagkasunduang tungkulin at tumutulong tukuyin ang tanong na dapat linawin sa responsable. Hindi kapalit ng awtorisadong propesyonal na pagtatasa o nais ng residente ang peer help. Tiyakin ang lokal na papel.

entries.question_en: What is the punong barangay's role in relation to a BHW?
entries.question_fil: Ano ang papel ng punong barangay sa isang BHW?
entries.answer_en: The DOH manual describes the punong barangay as a partner in basic health services, local leadership and administrative oversight. Match a practical support request to the responsible local contact and confirm process, approval and availability. Do not promise that one official can grant funding, payment or equipment alone. Authorized professional health guidance is a separate role.
entries.answer_fil: Inilalarawan ng DOH manual ang punong barangay bilang katuwang sa basic health services, lokal na pamumuno at administratibong pangangasiwa. Itugma ang praktikal na kahilingan sa responsableng lokal na contact at tiyakin ang proseso, pahintulot at kagamitan. Huwag mangako na isang opisyal ang makapagbibigay ng pondo, bayad o kagamitan nang mag-isa. Hiwalay ang awtorisadong propesyonal na gabay pangkalusugan.

entries.question_en: Who sits on the city or municipal local health board?
entries.question_fil: Sino-sino ang bumubuo sa city o municipal local health board?
entries.answer_en: The city or municipal mayor chairs the local health board, and the CHO/MHO is vice-chair. The Local Government Code also includes the sanggunian health committee chair, a private-sector or NGO representative involved in health, and a DOH representative. Verify any additional applicable representation and the current local membership. The board proposes annual budget allocations for health facilities and services and advises the sanggunian; it does not make an individual family’s clinical or assistance decision.
entries.answer_fil: Ang mayor ang chair ng city o municipal local health board, at ang CHO/MHO ang vice-chair. Kabilang din ayon sa Local Government Code ang chair ng komite sa kalusugan ng sanggunian, kinatawan ng pribadong sektor o NGO na may gawaing pangkalusugan, at kinatawan ng DOH. Tiyakin ang iba pang naaangkop na representasyon at kasalukuyang lokal na miyembro. Nagmumungkahi ang board ng taunang budget allocation para sa health facilities at services at nagpapayo sa sanggunian; hindi nito ginagawa ang indibidwal na klinikal o assistance decision ng pamilya.

entries.question_en: Who else does a BHW work with besides the four core relationships?
entries.question_fil: Sino pa ang kasama ng BHW bukod sa apat na pangunahing ugnayan?
entries.answer_en: The mayor leads the LGU; the BHW president may coordinate BHWs under local arrangements; a social welfare/development officer can advise on possible assistance subject to assessment and the current process; and a sanitary inspector handles environmental sanitation concerns. Confirm the local contact, seek consent, and share only necessary information. A BHW cannot promise funding.
entries.answer_fil: Namumuno ang mayor sa LGU; maaaring tumulong ang BHW president sa koordinasyon ayon sa lokal na kaayusan; ang social welfare/development officer ay maaaring magpaliwanag ng posibleng tulong ayon sa assessment at kasalukuyang proseso; at ang sanitary inspector ay katuwang sa environmental sanitation. Tiyakin ang lokal na contact, humingi ng pahintulot, at ibahagi lamang ang kailangan. Hindi maaaring mangako ng pondo ang BHW.

entries.question_en: What makes for good teamwork among BHWs?
entries.question_fil: Ano ang gumagawa ng mabuting teamwork sa mga BHW?
entries.answer_en: First, clarify why you volunteered: to improve community health. Second, clarify each member’s role and responsibility. Third, discuss issues affecting the work early. Describing the effect on the task is enough; private reasons do not have to be disclosed. Fourth, listen to feedback from colleagues and the community and use specific suggestions to improve the work. Fifth, build good relationships, including outside work, while respecting personal lives. Such social activities are voluntary. Nobody has to spend money, join a trip or take part in a close-contact physical game to prove they are a good teammate.
entries.answer_fil: Una, linawin kung bakit nagboluntaryo: upang mapabuti ang kalusugan ng komunidad. Ikalawa, linawin ang tungkulin at pananagutan ng bawat miyembro. Ikatlo, pag-usapan nang maaga ang isyung nakaaapekto sa trabaho. Sapat na sabihin ang epekto sa gawain; hindi kailangang ibunyag ang pribadong dahilan. Ikaapat, pakinggan ang puna ng kasamahan at komunidad at gamitin ang tiyak na mungkahi upang mapabuti ang gawain. Ikalima, bumuo ng mabuting ugnayan, maging sa labas ng trabaho, nang may paggalang sa personal na buhay. Boluntaryo ang ganitong pakikisalamuha. Walang kailangang gumastos, sumama sa biyahe, o makipagdikit sa pisikal na laro upang patunayang mabuting kasamahan.

entries.question_en: What self-management skills should a BHW have?
entries.question_fil: Anong mga kasanayan sa self-management ang dapat taglayin ng isang BHW?
entries.answer_en: Six: being reliable, stress management, time management, being trustworthy, adaptability, and being honest and careful. These are skills a BHW needs for their own performance, separate from the skills used to relate to others.
entries.answer_fil: Anim: pagiging maasahan, stress management, time management, pagiging mapagkakatiwalaan, adaptability, at pagiging matapat at maingat. Mga kasanayan itong kailangan ng BHW para sa sariling pagganap, hiwalay sa kasanayang ginagamit sa pakikitungo sa iba.

entries.question_en: How can a BHW improve their self-management?
entries.question_fil: Paano mapapabuti ng isang BHW ang kanyang self-management?
entries.answer_en: Practice self-care, train yourself to be patient, finish one task at a time, reflect on your own abilities, set SMART goals, plan each week's work in writing, come to meetings prepared, and think before speaking. These are habits, not a trait someone either has or lacks.
entries.answer_fil: Mag-alaga sa sarili, sanayin ang pagiging matiyaga, tapusin ang isang gawain sa isang pagkakataon, pagnilayan ang sariling kakayahan, magtakda ng SMART goals, magplano ng bawat linggo nang nakasulat, dumalo sa pulong nang handa, at mag-isip muna bago magsalita. Mga ugali itong pinapaunlad, hindi katangiang taglay ka na o wala.
